text: nice now look here for me. notice how in the building workspace the skin looks like this [Image #1] [Image #2] in the iso3d editor, the front/back of the window is not the same as the front/back of the window in this building workspace. [Image #3] [Image #4]
resolution: Aligned iso/test/compiled wall face skins with the building workspace. The shared pieceVisualShapes wall decomposition now swaps front/back semantic face slots for odd quarter-turn walls, matching BuildingStage's yaw-90 convention where front is world -X. This fixes window walls and doorway walls because both use the same wall-family cutout decomposition. Added a compile/worldGeometry regression that checks yaw-90 window and doorway walls put front/back skins on the same sides as the building workspace.
